text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This one's from three years ago... and 
this one's last year? Man~ this brings 
back memories!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Mornin'. ...Quite the ruckus first thing 
in the morning. What'cha doing?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Nakayama and the others are here too! 
Mornin'! Wanna look with us, you two? Old 
photos!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Oh? What do we have here——

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Take a look at this, Nakayama. It's 
a photo from back when Miho's "Empress" 
was still sweet and innocent.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the Holy Hoof Festival play. ...Come 
to think of it, you had zero immunity to 
Fuji back then. Heh heh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
——Heeey, you two! Stop making stuff up! 
Hand that over!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Full of energy this morning, Dorm Head. 
So? Where'd these old photos come from?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
They turned up while I was cleaning my 
room yesterday. Brings back memories, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd put them in an album and 
leave it in the lobby, but spreading them 
out caused this whole commotion. ...Well, 
as long as everyone's having fun, it's all 
good!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Your class's photos are over there too! 
...Why don't you go check out your own 
innocent days?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh. Sounds good. Let's go worship the 
puppy-like Sirius-sama.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah. Cheeky as ever, junior.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ama-chan~ Can I have this photo? Even 
just digital data is fine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, no problem. Take all you want! 
...Oh, you came by too.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, dropping in again today! Still, 
these really bring back memories~.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Isn't this Hishiama-chan! Come to 
think of it, you were in a band with 
Brian-san, right!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
That was so amazing! You two were 
clashing, yet your timing was totally in 
sync~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey. I've been secretly wondering 
about this, but when did you two get so 
close?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! And also, Brian-san only ever 
attaches "-san" when calling Hishi 
Ama-chan, right? I was wondering why that 
is, too~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah, that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I wonder why myself!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: *Falls over* Eeeeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well~ it just ended up like that before I 
knew it, and I never really paid it any 
mind~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Well, who cares about the reason 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I hang out with her 'cause I want to, and 
she calls me that 'cause that's what she 
wants to call me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure reasons are really just that 
simple.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just like me sorting through these photos, 
and you guys being here with me. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's kinda embarrassing to hear! 
But... yeah. You're totally right!

During lunch break, invited by <chrname>, I visited 
the cafeteria to find――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Brian! Don't go picking out the green 
peas!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Eating this garbage won't change anything. 
You have them.
choice_data_list: (They sure get along well today too~)

text_block_list.text:
It's good to see friends getting along. 
Thinking that, I headed over to where <chrname> 
was.
